evidence.quote: BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE:

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Tennessee statute that recognizes a property right in an individual's name, photograph, voice or likeness and creates civil liability for unauthorized commercial use. It also reaches anyone who distributes a technology whose primary purpose is producing an identifiable individual's likeness or voice. Effective July 1, 2024.
summary.long: The Act amends the Tennessee Personal Rights Protection Act (Tenn. Code Ann. Title 47, Chapter 25, Part 11) and renames it the Ensuring Likeness, Voice, and Image Security Act of 2024. It adds 'voice' as a protected attribute with a definition that covers both actual and simulated voices, and it states that every individual has a property right in the use of their name, photograph, voice or likeness. Section 6 makes a person liable to a civil action for knowingly using an individual's name, photograph, voice or likeness for advertising, fundraising or sales without prior consent, with parental or guardian consent required for minors and executor, heirs or devisees for deceased individuals. Liability also attaches to knowingly making an individual's voice or likeness publicly available without authorization, and to distributing an algorithm, software, tool or other technology whose primary purpose is producing a particular identifiable individual's photograph, voice or likeness. Section 5 sets a post-death non-use termination period. Section 10 provides fair-use exceptions for news, commentary, scholarship, satire, parody, certain audiovisual representations and fleeting or incidental uses, and Section 11 extends a knowledge element to what a defendant reasonably should have known. Section 8 allows a contracting person to bring enforcement actions for recording-artist contracts. The Act specifies civil actions only and states no damages amounts. It takes effect July 1, 2024.

relations.note: Amends each of sections 47-25-1101 to 47-25-1107 by deleting or inserting text (Secs. 1-11). The unamended code text is not part of this document.

notes: Sec. 5 substitutes a new subdivision (b)(2) whose text runs on to a paragraph numbered (8) ('For purposes of subdivision (b)(2)(A)...'). The numbering is inconsistent and the intended placement is not stated. Sec. 3 adds a new subdivision to 47-25-1102 with a blank number '( )'. Sec. 8 inserts a new subsection (f) into 47-25-1106. Sec. 13 sets the effective date at July 1, 2024. Secs. 1 and 12 rename the Personal Rights Protection Act of 1984 as the Ensuring Likeness, Voice, and Image Security Act of 2024. The enacting public chapter and bill numbers appear only in registry metadata, not in the document, so no enacted_by_bill relation is recorded. The unamended code text is not included, so the consolidated sections as amended cannot be checked against this document.
